incident.candidate_defect: A valid retained-session proposal and signed O decision reached C3 without a derived authorization artifact, so execution failed before pending publication or hardware dispatch.
incident.watcher_procedure_kept_separate: The watcher service terminated, but the W agent returned before its helper exited and never authored its terminal report. The fresh watcher prompt will use an exact blocking helper invocation; no candidate or watcher framework change is admitted from that separate procedure failure.

initial_review.report_envelope_procedure_defect: The reviewer used firmware-review-result/v1, so the controller rejected its RESULT. ROOT accepted the independently valid, evidence-backed FINDINGS artifact and did not treat the envelope error as a candidate defect.

preserved_root_environment_failure.disposition: ROOT omitted the required inherited variable at launch. The run remains FAIL evidence; no product, runner, cleanup, or test change was made.

fresh_passing_run.report_envelope_correction: The same D2 thread changed only RESULT.schema from orchestrator-review-result/v1 to orchestrator-lane-result/v1 after the controller rejected the first envelope. Tests were not rerun and all raw execution artifacts were preserved.

A derivation failure leaves no operation future and no pending artifact.
The existing generic authorization path remains unchanged.
rejected_extra_engineering: No generic derivation branch or authorization adapter framework.
No helper extraction merely to remove localized validation duplication.
No extra path guards beyond existing session and controller-root containment contracts.
No bytecode cleanup or stable-runner environment behavior in the candidate.
